annotation.title_clean: 18 U.S. Code § 39B - Unsafe operation of unmanned aircraft
annotation.title_en: 18 U.S. Code § 39B - Unsafe operation of unmanned aircraft
annotation.authors_or_issuer: United States Congress (U.S. Code, Cornell LII)
annotation.summary_en: US federal criminal statute (18 U.S.C. § 39B, enacted 2018) penalizing unsafe operation of unmanned aircraft, including knowingly or recklessly interfering with occupied aircraft and unauthorized operation near airport runways, with escalating penalties up to life imprisonment where death or serious injury results.
key_provisions_or_claims: Criminalizes knowing or reckless interference with occupied aircraft by drone operation posing imminent safety hazard
Prohibits unauthorized drone operation in runway protection zones near class B, C, D airports
Base penalty: fine, up to 1 year imprisonment, or both
Serious injury or death from reckless interference: up to 10 years
Knowing interference causing death or serious injury: any term of years or life
